name: PreventiveMaintenancePlanner
tagline: Meter-aware PM calendar, compliance and one-click work orders for every asset.
description: Plant-wide preventive maintenance planning PCF control: asset × day calendar with time and meter triggers, overdue and due-soon tracking, labour load vs. craft capacity, PM compliance dashboard, deferrals and batch work-order generation outputs. Canvas, Model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Asset × day PM calendar (7–90 days) with overdue column
Time, meter and whichever-first triggers with meter projection
KPI strip incl. PM compliance vs. target
Compliance by area, craft and 12-week trend
Phone due list and bottom sheet
